programme.title: Dil Se
programme.desc: Journalist Amar falls for a mysterious woman on assignment but she does not reciprocate his feelings. Later, when Amar is about to get married, the woman shows up at his doorstep asking for help.

programme.title: Blackout

programme.title: Tevar
programme.desc: A kabaddi player tries to protect a young woman in Agra who is hounded by a deadly factional leader desiring to marry her against her wishes.

programme.title: Betting Raja
programme.desc: Raj leads a carefree life and gambles his life away. When his father is in need of expensive medical treatment, he bets on winning Chaitras love in exchange for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Main Aur Mr. Riight
programme.desc: Alia is often bullied by her friends for not having a boyfriend. She hires Sukhwinder to act as her boyfriend but things take a wrong turn when both Sukhwinder and Abhay, her friend, start liking her.

programme.title: Mirch Masala
programme.desc: A woman decides to fight against her powerful oppressor. When the guard of a chilli factory helps her, the women and the teacher of the village join them to openly defy the prevailing repression.

programme.title: Dedh Bigha Zameen

programme.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
programme.desc: The adopted but much loved older son of a rich couple is banished by his father when he chooses to marry a middle-class girl. With a desire to reunite his family, the younger son sets out to find him.

programme.title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
programme.desc: After reading the letter her mother had written for her before she died, Anjali decides to bring together her widowed father with his true love.
